verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an API error code describing a lock that prevents a customer from being billed twice for the same transaction. That indicates EBANX has its own duplicate-charge protection, but it is a single thin mention inside an error-code table. Missing for 10: documented idempotency-key header or parameter semantics, guidance on safely retrying any API request (not just payments), behavior and response on replayed requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can safely retry any API request using idempotency keys so network failures never create duplicate charges

citations.quote: Lock for preventing customer to be billed twice for the same transaction.
